title: Inside Anthropic: How Claude Tag Is Changing Agentic Work
description:
Claude Tag is reshaping how we work with AI agents. It’s not just about automation but about creating a proactive AI teammate that collaborates within Slack. When 65% of PRs are opened by Claude Tag, it highlights a shift towards a more engaged, capable AI presence in daily workflows. This is the unexpected leap forward from a side project to a transformative tool. 

Lamis Mukta, a Member of Technical Staff at Anthropic, joins Simon Maple to explore the journey from idea to execution. Positioned within Anthropic's applied AI team, Lamis gives insight into how Claude Tag builds on the legacy of Claude Code. With hands-on experience at the intersection of product research and direct customer interaction, Lamis shares what it took internally to make Claude Tag a ubiquitous tool for collaboration.

What we cover:
• What is Claude Tag, and how does it differ from Claude Code and Cowork?
• How does Claude Tag's proactive nature redefine AI capabilities?
• Why is trust in AI agents dependent on model capability?
• How does Anthropic ensure secure multiplayer AI with channel-level permissioning?
• How has Claude Tag improved workflow efficiency within Anthropic?
